about_the_game:
Idle Pizza Business Demo is a casual idle sim where you automate pizza production, upgrade gear and staff, and grow your empire.

Started with nothing but an empty lot, a crusty dough recipe, and an unhealthy obsession with domination through pizza.

Now? I run an empire.

In Idle Pizza Business, I built everything from the ground up—one greasy machine, one overworked staff member, one impatient customer at a time. Every slice that goes out the door lines my pockets, whether I’m there or not. That’s the power of automation, baby.

I built the machines.
I trained the staff.
I crushed the competition.

The Skills Department sharpened my edge—faster moves, bigger hauls, fatter profits. HR kept the drones in line, upgraded and pushing their limits. I added drive-thru service to keep the dough rolling, packaging stations to move product faster, dining tables to handle the rush.

Three locations.
Endless upgrades.
No sleep. Just pizza.

This demo features:

  • Offline Income – The money never stops.

  • Pizza Machines & Packaging Stations – Industrialize your operation.

  • Skills Department – Speed. Capacity. Profit. You’re not here to play nice.

  • HR Department – Hire, train, and squeeze every ounce of value from your crew.

  • Drive-Thru Window – More mouths. More money.

  • Dining Tables – Expand. Accommodate. Dominate.

  • Upgrades Galore – If it moves, cooks, or carries, it can be improved.

It’s not just pizza. It’s power.
And I’m not stopping ‘til I own every damn pepperoni on the map.
